title: Amoytiini ellecabo ambullee wayteh tan Amoytiini
intro: Aydaadi ummaan qaynatih miraacinu yaaxigeh, takkay immay dagoomuy tannal amrisen. Caacay isih ken amri gacsa abeeh, taama abeenit inkih tibba inteh taamitak sugteeh, ta doolat dumaak sugteeh, sarra elle sugtennal sugte. Usuk kaadu kaxxa doolat gaba kaltam faxximta—kee tama num gaba kalteh tan waqdi, numma elle tamixxigem, numtin amoh raceenah addat tan.
clues: Anu fidin amoytiinu yoh yeceeh yi degelti, diini galittel yaabe.
Anu kaxxa wale kee reeda yok naharal diini luk gexak sugte xaleenak naggaareh.
Anu kaxxa caacay amriseh, yi hadafah baxxo gexe.
qaadik tan intiitat ambulle wayta gino yi reedah gubat taamitte, qeedaalissok iroh assakat le xisne.
Yalli dooreh yan marih fanak baxsale barkat yoh caxteh tan laqlaqinte nacaas raceenaani yoh caxitta.
Anu ta baadal gexe wak, yi dagar adoytit qagitak soolak suge. dubuk qunxa ardi gineenit too adoytiitih gabuuk yokme wak yi dariifal yan mari anu tatrem cede.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Rabi yi adoytiitih gabuuk yakme gineenat baxxaqimte
trial.answer: Rabi yi adoytiitih gabuuk yakme gineenat baxxaqimte

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Jinni taamat suge adoytit yakmem fan.
Yi ummatta kaxxa doonik addat cattimte
Caylale agat finqiseh qangiino le silaytut.
outcome.answer: Jinni taamat suge adoytit yakmem fan.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
